------
06/12.03.2025 I.A. No. 2258 of 2025 Heard the parties.

2. This Interlocutory Application has been filed for making necessary amendment in the prayer portion of the Cr.M.P. No. 1539 of 2019 to include prayer for quashing of order dated 05.07.2024,
whereby and wherein, the learned Trial Court has taken cognizance against the petitioner under Sections 406 & 420 of the I.P.C. after submission of charge-sheet.
3.

Mr. R. S. Mazumdar, learned senior counsel has appeared on behalf of O.P. No. 02.
4. The prayer for necessary amendment in the prayer portion of Cr.M.P. No. 1539/2019 is allowed.
5. Accordingly, this Interlocutory Application is allowed.
Necessary amendment shall be made by the learned lawyer appearing on behalf of the petitioner during the course of day.
Gaurav Kumar @ Gaurav Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand on 12 March, 2025
